pages.setting: Family kitchen beside the newly prepared baby area at night
pages.mainAction: The child gently swirls a water-filled jar as the tiny transparent fish inside brightens blue, while Dini steadies the wrapped jar.
pages.lighting: Warm household light contrasted with the fish's soft blue glow

pages.setting: Kitchen doorway and window overlooking the gutter
pages.mainAction: The child blows bubbles through a straw into the jar as Dini removes the towel; the bright fish casts a blue beam toward the waking gutter while a snail overtakes Dini.
pages.lighting: Warm interior night light with a vivid blue beam toward the window
continuityAnchors: same lidded jar with the glow-fish
same thick towel being removed from the jar

pages.setting: Quiet gray street with nearly dry rain channels and a bench
pages.mainAction: The child tilts the jar above the first channel while Dini pours in water; a frog splashes, snails clear leaves, and a moth guides the newly glowing flow.
pages.lighting: Dim moonlit street awakened by blue light in the moving water
continuityAnchors: same unwrapped jar with the glow-fish
removed towel now carried by Dini

pages.setting: Street-end blockage beside a wooded grove and old waterwheel
pages.mainAction: The child opens one narrow gap with a twig as the frog and snails clear two others; three streams strike the wheel while Dini wears a comic mud cap.
pages.lighting: Cool night light with faint blue streams brightening the dusty wheel
continuityAnchors: same glow-fish jar nearby
frog and three snails continue along the channel
Dini's towel remains soaked

pages.setting: Reawakened waterways throughout the wooded grove
pages.mainAction: The child organizes a visible relay along the stream as Dini and the small helpers guide the glowing jar past roots, stones, and bends through the revived grove.
pages.lighting: Blue water-light spreads through the dark grove beneath soft night light
continuityAnchors: old waterwheel now turning
same jar carrying the glow-fish
Dini remains wet and muddy
frog, snails, and moths continue helping

pages.setting: High nursery garden crossed by seven cracked channels before the spring
pages.mainAction: From a stone, the child opens the small gate as the helpers connect all seven streams; the glow-fish leaps from the jar onto the joined rush of water.
pages.lighting: Thin predawn light with bright blue water tracing every connected channel
continuityAnchors: same jar with the glow-fish
Dini remains wet and muddy
frog, snails, and moths maintain their relay

pages.mainAction: A school of glowing fish surrounds the reunited fish as the child waves from shore; muddy Dini sits nearby with the frog perched on her head.
pages.lighting: Soft predawn sky over luminous blue circles beneath the water
continuityAnchors: released glow-fish now in the spring
Dini remains soaked and mud-covered
same frog accompanies the group

pages.setting: Quiet sleeping area with the child's bed, baby crib, and nearby rug
pages.mainAction: A blue ripple from the gutter crosses the ceiling above the baby crib and reaches the child's pillow while Dini opens one eye from the rug.
pages.lighting: Dim warm bedtime light with gentle blue reflections across the ceiling
continuityAnchors: same tiny baby hat from the prepared sleeping area
Dini remains muddy
small spring shell rests beside the baby hat
